label: reference-retry-trunk
method: Native canvas + original mixed stereo audio, no manual simulation steps, no position assignment during clips. Independent matched setup before clips; four camera angles are explicitly timed. 800x600 DPR1, seed12345, June21 clear. Software renderer: no hardware or perceptual validation.

planet.floatingOrigin: integrated render/audio origin; canonical simulation and storage unchanged

transport.provenance: Synthetic traffic on imported OSM infrastructure; no real timetable, flight or passenger service.

buffers.scope: CPU mirrors of loaded geometry and typed textures; excludes driver allocation, compression, render targets and untyped image textures

cases.prerollMethod: Native RAF only; wait for three actual production frames before the requested recording interval so an empty encoder under load cannot masquerade as a clip. Preroll remains in original media and measured FPS/durations.
